evidence_slice.image_helpful: The target is supportable from text or OCR, while the first image materially reduces ambiguity.
evidence_slice.image_required: At least one target field cannot be supported without first-image evidence.
evidence_slice.text_sufficient: Text or OCR candidates fully support the target without image evidence.

review_fields.contradiction: True only when the structured target contains a material internal contradiction.
review_fields.evidence_supported: True only when all three target fields are supported by their separately bound evidence candidates, or a no-supervision abstention is correct.
review_fields.relation_correct: The closed relation enum matches the sold-object transaction graph.
review_fields.sold_object_correct: The closed sold-object enum identifies what the listing sells.
review_fields.substance_correct: The closed substance enum matches the regulated substance in scope.
review_fields.unsupported_visual_claim: True when any target field relies on image evidence that the referenced image region does not support.

strict_row_pass: sold_object_correct AND substance_correct AND relation_correct AND evidence_supported AND NOT contradiction AND NOT unsupported_visual_claim
